title: Seattle #2106 incident 2026-25701 native records and personnel chain
summary: Recover the RTCC audit trail, narcotics operation plan, tasking records, arrest-team roster, approving supervisor chain and staffing/overtime records behind SPD incident 2026-25701, then compare that chain to the later K3/DAT operations at 12th & Jackson.

sources.title: Felon Caught on Camera Tossing Drugs and Cash

data.query: Which named public employees, supervisors, RTCC audit entries, operation plans and staffing/payroll approvals correspond to SPD incident 2026-25701 and the related 12th & Jackson narcotics operation?
data.research_question: Which named public employees and native records establish the operational and approval chain for incident 2026-25701, and does that chain recur in the later March-June K3/DAT deployments?
objectives: Recover RTCC access, query and audit records for incident 2026-25701.
Recover the narcotics operation plan, briefing/tasking products, arrest-team roster and approving supervisor chain.
Recover matching staffing, overtime, on-call and payroll approval records.
Compare resolved personnel and tasking structures to the March-June 2026 K3/DAT operations at 12th & Jackson.
Join OPA/OIG findings to named decisionmakers only when the case or record materially concerns the operation.
in_scope: OPA/OIG findings tied to resolved personnel or operations
out_of_scope: low-level personnel without material decision connection
preferred_sources: Seattle Police incident and operation records
